At Modern IT, you'll turn security priorities into tested controls, reliable automation and useful AI. Prove improvements internally, then help turn them into repeatable services for our managed-security clients. You'll work alongside our existing team lead and certified experts who care deeply about their craft. Collaborate on challenging problems, share knowledge and learn from one another as you grow your skills and career. You'll own agreed improvements from discovery through implementation and handoff, with teammates to challenge ideas and support delivery. Preferred schedule: 2p.m.-11 p.m. or 3 p.m.-12 a.m. Pacific time, following Pacific daylight-saving changes. We welcome applicants globally whose local hours support this schedule without overnight work. Share your availability; we'll agree on a sustainable schedule together. What You Will Own Strengthen security foundations. Improve identity, access, endpoints, cloud services and recovery readiness. Prioritize risks with the team and verify that controls work Build reliable automation. Use scripts, APIs and workflows to reduce repetitive investigations, control checks and evidence collection. Include testing, scoped permissions, logging, exception handling and rollback Apply AI responsibly. Improve investigation, scripting and analysis while protecting sensitive information, validating outputs and defining human review. Help secure the AI tools and integrations we adopt Connect compliance and response to daily work. Maintain control evidence, track remediation and improve incident playbooks with the team and relevant partners. Communicate clearly with people affected Make improvements repeatable. Pilot changes internally, document deployment and support, and prepare successful approaches for clients. Teach teammates and use feedback to make secure work simpler Your first 90 days Agree on priorities with the team, deliver a useful automation with a measured result, verify a priority security control, and document an improvement another teammate can operate. Together, select a successful approach to prepare for a client pilot. Requirements Hands-on experience implementing security controls, investigating issues and connecting requirements to credible evidence. You can explain your decisions and their business impact Experience building and troubleshooting scripts or API integrations using PowerShell, Python or a comparable language, with testing and documentation others can follow Sound judgment about AI, data handling and verification; ownership through delivery and handoff; and the judgment to escalate when needed Clear written and spoken communication. You listen, explain tradeoffs and help technical teammates and people outside IT adopt changes without blame At least one active Microsoft certification: Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200), Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300), or Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert. Include a public Microsoft Learn verification link in your application. A passed exam alone does not meet this requirement MSP, Microsoft cloud security and workflow automation experience are helpful. Show us what you have built, improved and learned. Benefits Build your skills through collaboration with certified, passionate peers and meaningful work across Modern IT and our clients. Help shape security practices that save people time and build confidence.
